{"consolidated_memory":"## Spurious 429 Rate Limiter Issues in api/gateway/rate_limit.go

Two separate incidents of spurious 429 throttling errors in the API gateway rate limiter, both manifesting the same signal but with distinct root causes and fixes.

**Occasion 1: March 19, 2026 - Timezone Awareness Issue**
- File: api/gateway/rate_limit.go
- Problem: spurious 429 responses from rate limiter
- Signal: throttle counters far above configured ceiling
- Trigger: affected only clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root Cause: naive (timezone-unaware) datetime compared against aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #4328, branch: fix/spurious-429-1
- Repro: replay the saved burst fixture
- Test Coverage: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go (Go stack)
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 48 consecutive days

**Occasion 2: May 21, 2026 - Race Condition on Concurrent Writes**
- File: api/gateway/rate_limit.go
- Problem: spurious 429 responses from rate limiter
- Signal: throttle counters far above configured ceiling
- Trigger: when two requests raced on the same key
- Root Cause: two writes to rate limit counters never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #6560, branch: fix/spurious-429-2
- Repro: replay the saved burst fixture
- Test Coverage: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go (Go stack)
- Outcome: throughput increased 56%, reaching 131 requests per second

Both occasions had identical symptom presentation but completely different root causes and remedies."}
